description: Unit test code for the HTTP/2 GOAWAY payload decoder, including tests for frame truncation, opaque data length validation, and decoder behavior.

classes.name: GoAwayPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the GOAWAY frame type and payload decoding flags.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Collects frame parts and handles GOAWAY frame events during decoding.

classes.name: GoAwayPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture for GOAWAY payload decoder tests, inherits from abstract payload decoder test base.

methods.name: FrameType
methods.description: Returns the frame type for GOAWAY.

methods.name: FlagsAffectingPayloadDecoding
methods.description: Returns flags that affect payload decoding, here always 0.

methods.name: OnGoAwayStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a GOAWAY frame during decoding.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Handles frame size errors during decoding.
